descripcion: Schema for the request section of the workflow
description: Request that is used by APPS to retrieve data from the fdb, and for the MODEL to find the correct data in the fdb (used in DQC, AQUA).

CLASS.description: Experiment class for data government. `d1` is production(?), `rd` is research.

EXPVER.description: Experiment version string used to identify experiments. Needs to be `0001` for production experiments.

FDB_HOME.description: Home directory of the fdb that is to be used.
